gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes that define the electrode array configuration used for an in-situ electrical resistivity test. These codes are used for the value of the arrayType property of the InsituResistivityTest object.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Electrode Array Type Codes

diggs:Definition.gml:description: Four electrodes in a line at equal separation "a" - the outer pair injects current, the inner pair measures potential. DIGGS structures this array through diggs:ResistivityReading/diggs:electrodeSpacing.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Wenner

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A closely spaced potential electrode pair at the centre of a more widely, and in a sounding progressively, spaced current electrode pair. DIGGS structures this array through diggs:ResistivityReading/diggs:currentElectrodeSeparation and diggs:potentialElectrodeSeparation.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Schlumberger

diggs:Definition.gml:description: A current dipole and a potential dipole of equal length, offset from each other by a multiple (n) of that length, both dipoles moved together as the array is stepped. DIGGS structures this array through diggs:ResistivityReading/diggs:dipoleLength and diggs:nFactor.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Dipole-Dipole
